comment: Densest recent T layout that stays on the dt=5 step grid (no sub-step aliasing, the r6 lesson): knots_recent_T + 1935,1945,1960,1970,1980, i.e. 5-10 yr spacing continuously from 1930 to the present (22 T knots). This is the empirical test of Andrew's request to add nodes for the borehole T change signal -- inverted, not just probed. Below-5-yr spacing in this window would need dt<2.5 (separate experiment). b knots unchanged.
